name: WooCommerce Memberships
couldBuild: Membership plans granted by product purchase, content restriction rules and a drip schedule keyed to the join date.
stillMissing: It only makes sense welded to WooCommerce and usually Subscriptions too, so you inherit that compatibility surface — every Woo release, every gateway, every theme's account-page override. The plugin is small; the matrix around it is not.
requirements: Plans granted by purchase, manual assignment or registration
Content restriction across posts, taxonomies and products
Drip scheduling relative to the member's own start date
Member discounts applied correctly at cart and checkout
Account area showing plan status and what it unlocks

alternatives.name: Paid Memberships Pro
alternatives.desc: Free core that covers restriction and levels without WooCommerce.

alternatives.name: Restrict Content
alternatives.desc: Simple content gating when you do not need commerce attached.
